steps.title: Choose the brand
steps.detail: Pick the manufacturer you are shopping for. Their site opens in a new tab, and this page stays open behind it.

steps.title: Copy the appliance link
steps.detail: On their site, copy the link to the appliance you want, then paste it into the enquiry box.

steps.title: Fill in your details
steps.detail: Your name, phone, email and where you are. Then we price it and reply.

home.title: Appliance, TV and audio quotes by email
home.description: Choose any appliance, television or audio product on the manufacturer’s own website, send us the model, and we will email you a price within 24 hours.

hero.headline: Fast delivery isn't an upgrade. It's our standard.
hero.supporting: Kitchen appliances, laundry, televisions and audio — Miele, Smeg, Sony, LG and dozens more.
hero.process: Choose your appliance on the manufacturer's website, send us the model number, and we will email you a quote within 24 hours.

howItWorks.heading: How it works
howItWorks.intro: We do not sell online. You choose the exact appliance on the manufacturer’s own website, send us the model, and we come back with a price.

about.heading: About us
about.body: We are an independent electrical retailer and a member of Euronics, the buying group behind independent retailers across Europe. That is how a shop like ours can supply the brands listed on this page.
about.credentials: Every enquiry is priced by a person who knows the range, so you can ask about anything a manufacturer makes — not only the models that happen to be listed on a website.

order.title: Request a quote
order.description: Pick a brand, send us the model number or a link from the manufacturer’s website, and add your details. We reply to every enquiry within 24 hours.

step1.heading: Choose a brand
step1.intro: Most of this happens on the manufacturer’s own website — you come back here with the link to the appliance you want.
step1.skip: Already have a model number? Skip to step 2

step2.heading: Add your appliance
step2.intro: On the manufacturer’s site, open the appliance you want and copy the link from your browser’s address bar. Paste it below and we will work out the model from it.
step2.alternatives: No link to hand? The model number from the product page is enough on its own — and if you have not settled on a model yet, describe what you are after instead.
step2.describeSummary: Not sure — describe what you’re after
step2.describeLabel: Tell us what you’re looking for
step2.describePlaceholder: A quiet integrated dishwasher, ideally within 60cm

step3.heading: Your details
step3.intro: Five short questions — everything we need to price your enquiry and get back to you. You can change any answer before you send it.

name.question: What name should we put on the quote?
name.label: Your name

phone.question: What is the best number to reach you on?
phone.label: Phone number

email.question: Where should we send the quote?
email.label: Email address

country.question: Which country are we delivering to?
country.label: Country

step3.consent: I agree to my details being used to reply to this enquiry.

submit.retrying: Still trying — this can take a few seconds.
submit.failureHeading: We could not send your enquiry
submit.failureBody: Nothing has been lost. Your enquiry is saved on this device and we will keep trying to send it.
submit.blockedHeading: We could not accept that from this browser
submit.blockedBody: This can happen with some browser extensions and automated tools. Try again, or send your enquiry to us directly.
submit.limitHeading: That is several enquiries from this device
submit.limitBody: We have not sent this one. If it is a separate enquiry, send it to us directly and we will pick it up with the others.
submit.whatsappNote: This opens WhatsApp with your enquiry already written out.
submit.recovered: Your earlier enquiry reached us. Reference

step4.heading: Enquiry sent
step4.referenceNote: Quote this if you get in touch before we reply.
step4.whatsappNote: Useful if you want to send us a screenshot of the appliance.
step4.whatsappPrefill: I have just sent an enquiry through your website. My reference is
step4.intro: That is everything we need. Your enquiry is with us and nothing further is needed from you.

footer.note: All brand names and logos are the trademarks of their respective owners. We confirm every model, price and delivery date by email before an order is placed.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.description: That page does not exist. Start a quote enquiry or return to the home page.
notFound.heading: That page does not exist
notFound.body: The link may be out of date, or we may have moved the page. Nothing is wrong with your enquiry — anything you had saved is still here.
